identity.title: Folklore Clinical Variant Interpretation MCP
identity.task: Classify and interpret one supported public GRCh38 germline SNV or simple indel under ACMG/AMP with structured evidence, provenance and related literature. Retrieve ClinGen Gene-Disease Validity assertions for a public gene or disease as a separate genomic evidence workflow.

positiveIntents: search biomedical literature with exact identifiers
find genes associated with a disease
find diseases associated with a gene
genomic analysis evidence after variant calling

Review the evidence for this VUS.

Which diseases have curated assertions for BRCA1?

accepted: public gene symbol or HGNC identifier for gene-disease tools
public disease name or MONDO identifier for gene-disease tools

routing.job: resolve, classify, interpret or review one public variant
find publications linked to one supported variant
retrieve a complete record for a returned PMID
search the biomedical literature or compare papers
retrieve ClinGen assertions for an exact gene symbol or HGNC identifier
